tools.name: briefing
tools.description: The daily aipozi read for all of the person's sites, or one: for each site, how many of today's answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity named it (and gave its address) and the change since yesterday, per AI; the questions it was named for today and by which AI; the questions lost since y

tools.name: list_my_sites
tools.description: Every site the person watches in aipozi: its id, plan (paid or free), market, last check time, how many answers named it and gave its address, per AI, its DR and the last 7 days. Use it to see which sites exist, or to get a site id for another tool.

tools.name: questions
tools.description: One site's questions (up to 10) and, for each, the result from each AI in the latest check (named with the address, named, address given but not named, not named), how many AIs named the site on each of the last 7 checks, and who was named instead. Use it for "which of my questions did ChatGPT name

tools.name: ai_answer
tools.description: One question and one AI: that AI's answer word for word, exactly as stored, with the pages it cited, from the latest check or a given date. Quote it as that AI's words. Use it for "show me exactly what ChatGPT said" or "who did Perplexity recommend for the Comrades question?".

tools.name: rivals
tools.description: For one site, or all of them: who ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity recommend instead, from the latest check. Each rival's name and domain, what they do, domain age, DR, how often each AI named them, the questions they won, first seen, the trend and a New flag for young sites. The person's own

tools.name: rival_detail
tools.description: One rival from the person's own checks: its age and registrar, DR, what it does, and every question and AI where it was named and the person's site was not, with that AI's words about it. Use it for "how old is that site and what's its DR?" about a rival, or "what did the AIs say about Linktree?". R

tools.name: trend
tools.description: Daily named and linked counts per site and per AI over 7, 30 or 90 days, with the moves marked done on the timeline and what changed since each. Use it for "how have I moved this month?" or "did the comparison page work?".

tools.name: domain_rating
tools.description: Ahrefs Domain Rating (0 to 100) for up to 25 domains, anyone's. Free, no sign-in. Every answer carries "Domain Rating by Ahrefs (ahrefs.com)"; show it with the numbers.

tools.name: action_plan
tools.description: One site's plan from its latest check: why each AI does or doesn't name it (in plain words, from the real answers) and the moves, ranked by how many questions and AIs each can win, with the rivals each move beats and the pages the AIs read instead. Use it for "what should I improve first on biotree.

tools.name: build_prompt
tools.description: One move of a site's plan as a complete, self-contained brief for a coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor): the goal, the page or change, the exact questions it targets and which AIs missed them, the rivals recommended, the pages the AIs read (to study, not copy), page anatomy and schema, what not to do

tools.name: mark_move_done
tools.description: Records that a move has shipped: today's date and, optionally, the URL of the new page. From the next morning's check, briefing and trend show what changed since. Not destructive; undo with undo: true. The only tool that writes. Use it after the person (or their coding session) has shipped the move.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Is a domain name free? Use it whenever someone names an app, product or company, asks "find me a name with a free domain", "is there a .com for…", or "is X taken". Asks each registry for its own record, live (RDAP, else the registry's WHOIS). One name: across .com, .ai, .io, .app, .dev and more, or

tools.name: domain_age
tools.description: A WHOIS / RDAP lookup for any domain: registration date and age, registrar, expiry, status (including expired and being deleted, with an estimated drop date), name servers and who hosts it, read live from the registry's own record (RDAP, else WHOIS). Plus its Ahrefs Domain Rating. Never owner detail

tools.name: ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Whether each AI's crawlers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Microsoft; search, user and training bots) are allowed by a site's robots.txt, read live, and the exact lines to add when a search crawler is blocked. Free, no sign-in.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_domain" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
